reviews.title: Attractive, High-Value Motherboard
reviews.comment: The MSI MAG Tomahawk Z790 motherboard is an excellent choice for any new pc build and presents a tremendous value for the money. I purchased this item as the centerpiece to my first custom built pc and could not be more pleased with the quality, aesthetics and overall functionality of the device. This item has a handy flash BIOS button which makes updating the BIOS a breeze. Visually, this motherboard is sleek and sexy, with an understated military-industrial design that is inoffensive and lacks the cringe-inducing, unnecessary text (i.e. "gamerz unite") found on comparable motherboards. The MSI BIOS is easy enough to use and did not present me with any problems. For the money, I'd be hard pressed to find a motherboard that's higher quality or more visually appealing. I like that this motherboard is simple, elegant and easy to understand. I had no trouble installing this hardware. The heatsinks are high quality and durable. As a first time pc builder, I couldn't have chosen a better motherboard to round out my build. I'd gladly buy another MSI motherboard for a future build in light of my experience with the Tomahawk Z790--I really can't say enough good things about this product.
reviews.author: Joseph Martinez

reviews.title: MSI for the win
reviews.comment: The best motherboard I've ever tested in this price range and quite frankly all you need for a 14900k unless you need to have a Gen 5 SSD in your build. Broad range of connectivity with several USB C ports Fantastic bios interface that is easy to use and configure to DRASTICALLY improve CPU performance if you're willing to put in the work in learning it Fantastic VRMs, very powerful, responsive, and stable power delivery that handles the i9-14900k well Sleek all black look Cons No Gen 5 SSD Support (for me that's not an issue since it's truly not needed for most users especially gamers like myself) VRMs can run a touch hot if you don't have enough case fans are running full load, generally NOT an issue
reviews.author: Dan

reviews.title: DO NOT BUY MSI-if you do, check your CPU socket pins!!!
reviews.comment: I would give a negative star review if I could.  I am a very experienced system builder...and I build custom rigs for my customers.  I have been an a MSI supporter for years...however, for this custom build MSI has let me down hard.  My customer settled on this board, and I got it on order, originally showed 2 day shipping, and then came all the delays.  Got it week late.  As I unboxed the MB, I noticed a sticker that was removed from the box, this should have been my first clue that something was wrong.  The MB was not wrapped in the static bag as a usual item should be, and it was a bit open, second clue.  As I lifted the MB out of the box, I heard it rattle, the socket pin protector was at the bottom of the bag...WTF. I pulled the MB out of the bag, and immediately saw 3 pins missing from the socket.  I pulled out my inspection scope for a closer look, and found 6 missing pins, drop the pictures (attached) it might be hard to see them all...but 6 are missing. When this MB was purchased, I checked the purchase new box, and I got a damaged, unusable, piece of garbage...SHAME ON YOU MSI!!! Had I not been as experienced,  these flaws could have damaged the CPU, memory, on and on...SHAME!!! The customer was very disappointed as this system was for his sons Birthday which is in less than one week due to the first delay...and now this won't be ready until after his son's birthday...I am beyond crushed over this after talking very highly about MSI to my customers...the customer also elected to go with an ASUS MB as a replacement for this epic failure...SHAME!!!

reviews.title: A powerful motherboard worth every penny.
reviews.comment: I've been using the MSI MAG Z790 Tomahawk WiFi motherboard for over a year now, and I must say, it's been an absolute powerhouse in my build. Specifications: Processor: Intel Core i7-13700K 3.4 GHz 16-Core Processor CPU Cooler: DeepCool Assassin IV 79.1 CFM RAM: G.SKILL Flare X5 Series (AMD EXPO) DDR5 RAM 32GB (2x16GB) 6000MT/s Storage: Two Samsung SSDs – 970 EVO Plus 2TB (for games) and 980 Pro 1TB (for OS) Graphics Card: XFX Speedster MERC 310 Radeon RX 7900 XT 20GB Case: NZXT H5 ATX Mid Tower Power Supply: Corsair RM850x (2021) 850 W 80+ Gold Certified Fully Modular ATX Performance: The combination of the Intel Core i7-13700K and the MSI MAG Z790 motherboard has delivered impeccable performance. From gaming to multitasking, this setup handles everything I throw at it with ease. The motherboard's robust VRM design ensures stable power delivery, even when the system is under heavy load. Cooling: The DeepCool Assassin IV paired with this motherboard provides excellent cooling. I’ve seen impressive temperature control, even during intense gaming sessions and CPU-heavy tasks. The motherboard's layout also facilitates good airflow within the NZXT H5 case. Storage and Speed: Having two Samsung SSDs ensures blazing-fast boot times and seamless gaming experiences. The 970 EVO Plus for games and the 980 Pro for the OS work perfectly, thanks to the motherboard's efficient storage management. Graphics and Gaming: The XFX Speedster MERC 310 Radeon RX 7900 XT graphics card, supported by the MSI MAG Z790, offers stunning visuals and a smooth gaming experience. The PCIe 5.0 slots provide the necessary bandwidth for the GPU to perform at its best. Memory: The G.SKILL Flare X5 Series DDR5 RAM at 6000MT/s ensures that there’s no bottleneck when it comes to multitasking and running memory-intensive applications. The motherboard's compatibility with high-speed RAM is a definite plus. Connectivity: The WiFi and Ethernet capabilities of the MSI MAG Z790 are top-notch, ensuring a stable and fast internet connection whether I'm gaming online or watching stuff. Overall: The MSI MAG Z790 Tomahawk WiFi motherboard is a fantastic choice for anyone looking to build a high-performance PC. Its compatibility with the latest components and its robust build quality make it a reliable centerpiece for any gaming or productivity setup. I highly recommend it!
reviews.author: Kimberly Melendez
